line: A reconstruction: an invented fellowship's teaching tape. Every lesson is quoted or closely paraphrased from a ministry handbook, two Exodus booklets and a class manual (1993–1996); every commercial is built on a real period product, price or flyer (1987–2001). All are held in the Smithsonian's Love in Action Collection.

facts.text: December 1973: the American Psychiatric Association's Board of Trustees voted to remove homosexuality from the DSM.
facts.source: Jack Drescher, “Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality”, Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575, 2015 (PMC4695779), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ read 15 Nov 2026

facts.text: 1987: “ego-dystonic homosexuality” was removed from the next revision, DSM-III-R.
facts.source: Jack Drescher, “Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality”, Behavioral Sciences 5(4):565–575, 2015 (PMC4695779), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ read 15 Nov 2026

facts.text: May 1990: the World Health Assembly adopted ICD-10 (WHA43.24; in effect from 1 January 1993). ICD-10, block F66, Note: “Sexual orientation by itself is not to be regarded as a disorder.”
facts.source: World Health Organization, ICD-10 (browser, 2019 version), block F66, Note, https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en/GetConcept?ConceptId=F66 read 15 Nov 2026; adoption “May 1990 (WHA43.24)”, https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases read 15 Nov 2026

invented: TriedPath Fellowship, its Pocket Library, the “Mountains of Material” cassette set, the Un-Walk Steps class, the fellowship hall, the phone numbers (fictional 555-01xx), Lamby's bubbles and the felt board are the piece's. The Roots & Recovery video and the Women Relating to Men flyer are real; their words are quoted, their makers' and presenters' names are not used. No real person is shown or named.
music: Music: made in code for these tapes by Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5) — the bed “Open Door” (1997-B); the commercials' jingles are v3's (made in code for this tape, S389)
voices: Build-time Supertonic 3 through tools/tts/render.py, register 'apparatus' only: narrator stock voice F3 (0.92, 14 steps), announcer M1 (0.97, 16 steps). Lamby has no voice.
